Subject: Private VPC architecture review - FinPay

Hi Alex —

Great speaking with you and Sam on the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Recap (from our side)
- Primary goal: deploy Redwood Private (VPC) behind FinPay's network for regulated workloads (PII tokens).
- Key constraints: dedicated routing through your VPC, strict egress controls, KMS integration, and audit logging retention of 13 months.
- Success metric: production inference at 100 qps with 95th pct latency < 120ms for short prompts.

Recommended next step: a 60‑minute Private/VPC architecture review with our solutions engineer to walk your infra team through the proposed topology, firewall rules, required peering/VPN options, and a checklist for on‑prem vs. cloud deployment.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Mar 3 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Wed Mar 4 — 1:00–2:00 PM PT
- Thu Mar 5 — 9:00–10:00 AM PT

Please let me know which slot works best or share a few times that suit your infra and procurement folks. I’ve attached a very rough network diagram and our discovery notes for context (FinPay_Network_Diagram_v1.pdf).

Agenda (we'll keep tight):
1) Introductions + scope (5 min)
2) Proposed VPC/peering topology and options (20 min)
3) Security controls: KMS, access & audit logs, data flow (15 min)
4) Deployment timeline and next steps (10 min)
5) Q&A / items for procurement (10 min)

Cc'ing Marissa (our SE) to join the call — she will lead the topology discussion. Happy to send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks,

—Aditya Rao

Thanks Aditya — good recap. Wed Mar 4 at 1:00–2:00 PM PT works best for our infra folks. I've looped in Sam (infra) and procurement so we can cover SOW/timing questions.

A couple of quick notes before the call:
- Our primary cloud is us-west-2 (AWS).
- We prefer Shared VPC peering or Transit Gateway options over site‑to‑site VPN for production.
- Can your SE confirm whether Redwood requires any specific NAT/Gateway egress IP ranges? If so, we need those for firewall rules.

Also attaching the CIDR ranges and current peering policy for our VPC (attached in our systems) — I'll bring the formal network details to the meeting.

On the calendar: Wed Mar 4, 1:00 PM PT (please send the invite).

Appreciate it — Alex
